lines.quote: not AI slop… it's science. And yes, it is capitalism.
what makes all this possible? Free available pools of capital in a deregulated economy
saying it's cool for a car to fly doesn't make you an evil materialist. It makes you a human.
lines.zWhy: the defence of the product implies the system that made it

lines.quote: top AI companies are in America… capex has to be high… only happens in the United States
state capitalism… China… Hitler's Germany could produce nice cars
lines.zWhy: the comparison sets up free markets as the winner

lines.quote: so many Americans want China-like economic fascism. The left wants it, the right wants it. It's wrong.
lines.note: the charge-word, aimed at both sides — close to the Codex's definition
lines.zWhy: implies the free market as the alternative

lines.quote: a fascistic economy and a fascistic country
the top of the heap free market capitalism, second state capitalism, third the heavily regulated economy… Europe
lines.note: a ranking of modes — a functional move

lines.quote: Macron's Citroën: 'a hideous piece of crap'
lines.zWhy: the ugly car stands in for the regulated economy

lines.quote: communism, which so many in America are also calling for… communism sucks
lines.note: THE WORD — a charge, with a straw ('so many')
lines.zWhy: the verdict line implies capitalism delivered

lines.quote: California high-speed rail as a communism exhibit
lines.note: a state project filed under the wrong mode
lines.zWhy: offered as proof of the thesis

lines.quote: the Yugo: a woman blown off a bridge

lines.zWhy: offered as proof of the thesis

lines.quote: capitalism is great and communism sucks.
